name: cx-findings-to-fix
description: Findings-to-Fix builds on Checkmarx One Triage Assist and Remediation Assist. Triage Assist has already evaluated the findings on the platform using Attackability-based context (reachability, exploitability, code context, policy) and confirmed the ones that require action. The plugin takes only those confirmed findings, asks Remediation Assist to generate the review-ready fix, and brings it into the developer's editor. The agent proposes; the developer approves. Run /cx-findings-to-fix:fix in the project you want to fix: it pulls only the findings Triage Assist has confirmed on your branch, requests fixes from Remediation Assist, and applies each as an edit you review and can undo.
